parts.latex: A point $(-1, -3)$ lies on the function $y = f(x)$. What are the coordinates of the new point when the function is transformed to $y = f(x-4)$ ?

solutions.latex:
The graph of $y=f(x-4)$ is the graph of $y=f(x)$ shifted $4$ units to the right.

So $x$ increases by $4$ and $y$ is unchanged.

$$(-1,-3) \text{ becomes } (-1+4,\,-3) = (3,-3)$$
